summary: Jason argues OpenAI has hit peak market share and will decline to roughly one-third of the AI market over the next four years, pressured by fierce competition from well-capitalized rivals making models free, eroding the $20/month subscription revenue base that represents 80% of OpenAI's income.
quote: I think we're going to see OpenAI go down to about a third of the market, and I think the other players are going to take two-thirds...80% of the revenue comes from $20 subscriptions. That's gonna get decimated to zero.
